paper_title: One-Electron Quantum Cyclotron as a Milli-eV Dark-Photon Detector
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing epsilon (chi), dimensionless, as plotted
notes: One-electron quantum cyclotron in Penning trap. Single measured limit at m_A' = 0.61227643 meV (148 GHz): epsilon < 3.2e-11 at 90% CL. This is 75x better than XENON1T/cosmology.
